title: Which Xpress license will the container use?

blocks.text: A team runs FICO Xpress from Python (`pip install xpress`) inside a container. The package's own page says how it finds a license: with no setting, it recognizes the free community license by itself; for a full license, you put the `xpauth.xpr` file in a folder and set the environment variable `XPRESS` to that **folder's** path, not the file's. The team wants its service to log, at start-up, which license it will get, so that a forgotten mount shows up in the first line of the log instead of as a size-limit error hours later.
Write `xpress_license(env, files)` in `xproute.py`. `env` is the container's environment, and `files` the set of file paths present in the container. Return:

items: `"community license"` when `XPRESS` is missing or empty;
`"XPRESS names the file; set it to the folder that holds xpauth.xpr"` when its value ends with `xpauth.xpr`;
`"license file <path>"` when `<folder>/xpauth.xpr` is in `files`, with the path joined by `posixpath.join`, so a trailing slash on the folder does no harm;
`"no xpauth.xpr in <folder>"` otherwise, with the folder as given.

blocks.text:
"""Run executes this file. Change the calls and see what prints. Submit grades."""
import logging

# Turn the logger up, so the `log.debug` lines of your code show under the printed lines.
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.DEBUG, format="%(levelname)s %(message)s")

from xproute import xpress_license

# A made-up environment and a made-up set of files in the container.
files = {"/srv/keys/xp/xpauth.xpr", "/srv/app/run.py"}
print("XPRESS=/srv/keys/xp:", xpress_license({"XPRESS": "/srv/keys/xp"}, files))
print("XPRESS=/srv/keys/xp/:", xpress_license({"XPRESS": "/srv/keys/xp/"}, files))
print("XPRESS=/srv/keys/xp/xpauth.xpr:", xpress_license({"XPRESS": "/srv/keys/xp/xpauth.xpr"}, files))
print("XPRESS=/srv/other:", xpress_license({"XPRESS": "/srv/other"}, files))
print("XPRESS unset:", xpress_license({"LANG": "C"}, files))

from __future__ import annotations

import posixpath


def xpress_license(env: dict[str, str], files: set[str]) -> str:
    """The license route an Xpress Python program in this container will take, from XPRESS and the files present."""
    # TODO: unset or empty, the file named instead of its folder, the file found, or the file missing.
    return ""


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(xpress_license({"XPRESS": "/licenses/xpress"}, {"/licenses/xpress/xpauth.xpr"}))
    print(xpress_license({}, set()))

cases.says: a folder holding xpauth.xpr gives that license file, and no XPRESS setting gives the community license
XPRESS set to the license file instead of its folder is reported as that mistake
a folder that holds no xpauth.xpr is reported, not trusted
a folder written with a trailing slash still finds the file inside it
XPRESS set to an empty string is the same as not set
